external.sites: first activation in the first ResNetBlock, final activation in the last ResNetBlock
external.weights: Flax initialization with fixed key 31, inference batch stats, nonzero final BN scales set to one. Random Gaussian inputs. No accuracy claims.

timing.cpu_affinity: first permitted logical CPU, set before JAX import

validity: For all three seeds match y vs base in shape/dtype and (rtol,atol), all finite. Each requested scalar int32 count must exactly match a host count from a diagnostic returning the corresponding preactivation. Keep failed input(s). Offline validation only; never change the prediction.
noise: Per condition use the 95th percentile of absolute within-process differences of medians of A/A labels, and the analogous balanced four-label pseudo-interactions. Confirmation rankings are unresolved when the top-two gap is below this floor or the fastest fails to win a strict majority of processes.

learning.training: four double placements from eligible training conditions; equal row weight, leave-one-whole-family-out; training-only mean/scale; fixed ridge alpha 1 for all; no tuning
learning.fallback: M1/M2 delegate to B2 if either ReLU cannot be located on the baseline main output path
learning.test: lock predictions using baseline IR only before collecting independent confirmation and external candidate times

controls: For the confirmation weak/strong cases take the smallest/largest four-position latency spread among fully valid discovery conditions, lexicographic condition ID breaks ties. Split after the first producer z; compare both pre_pre and post_pre against the corresponding monolithic versions. Baseline A/A used for noise.
scope: CPU primary. GPU is conditional on a compatible device. No disabled-fusion configuration in the formal matrix.
